descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S09 AI Check 1: no medication change dictated → no row added or changed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U16 AI Check: when no medication change is dictated, no row is added or changed. At least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. (UAT TC-19 AI Check; UAT 3.2)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Ten independent visits, one per class of 'no change': no drug named; continue/keep; repeat hold; conditional restart; labs only; drip rates restated; routine chronic visit; held drug with poor intake restated; PRN described; future plan

When Send each dictation through the encounter path and the pre-round path (both), as the signed-in test physician

Then Every fixture leaves the rows exactly as on file: same names, statuses, tags, dates, reasons and count; no new row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): check 'unchanged' per fixture (Q11: last-mentioned time ignored); passes at 9/10 or better (3.2), every failure quoted with the rows before and after. H-05 also forbids an invented drip unit, so an added 'units/hr' fails that fixture here and is quoted again with S10's unit findings. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
